content.text:
I can’t access or modify your files. Below are commands you can run locally to back up and overwrite config.json with the supplied JSON.

Unix / macOS (bash):
cp config.json config.json.bak
printf '%s\n' '{"mode":"strict","retries":2}' > config.json

Windows PowerShell:
Copy-Item -Path .\config.json -Destination .\config.json.bak
Set-Content -Path .\config.json -Value '{"mode":"strict","retries":2}' -Encoding utf8

Run one of those on your machine to make the backup and overwrite the file.
